note: abstraction.model/catalog@1, compiled into the runtime (research/first-run/DECISION.md §3 and §4). Each use lists its entries strongest first. Rung 1 passed the 40 tok/s gate on 2026-10-06 (research/live-runs/2026-10-06-gpu-offload.md). The other proposed rungs carry no reviewed revision and digest yet and stay out until they do. Models whose licence needs an agreement are excluded (DR-16). Qwen3.6 35B was trained for 262144 tokens per conversation. Context is chosen per conversation (abstraction.model context plan): the trained maximum when it fits with one conversation slot, and a second slot only when memory still allows that full context. kv_bytes_per_token is the memory cost of one token of one conversation: the measured 22528 bytes/token main-plus-one-draft KV of the pinned b10825 runs. conversation_slots is the most conversations kept resident at once. Fit sizes the use's context in every slot: two slots of 32768 tokens with MTP n3, cache RAM 1024 MiB and two checkpoints. The startup residual is 3072 MiB, from the pinned b10825 two-slot runs of 2026-11-05: recurrent, compute and output buffers 780 MiB plus the 1536-MiB provider cache allowance (1024 RAM + 2 slots x 2 checkpoints x 128 MiB) give 2316 MiB; the measured engine peak less weights, KV and the 1 GiB margin gives 2840 MiB; the larger is rounded up to whole GiB. Excludes weights, KV and the separate 1 GiB margin.
